title: Unit 12 Consolidation: Ingenuity, Design & Practical Problem-Solving

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can form and use the obligatory participle (-andó/-endő) across back-vowel, front-vowel, and irregular stems
I can express formal instrumentality and agency with révén, útján, segítségével, and által
I can construct purposive phrases with céljából, érdekében, and végett and deploy Unit 12's engineering vocabulary
